on:
  push:
     branches: [main] #codecov uses default branch for dashboard stat. recommended change the default branch from main to dev
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, edited, synchronize]
    paths:
      - "driver-portal/src/ClientApp/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ci-driver-portal-ui.yml"

env:
  IMAGE_NAME: driver-portal-ui
  working-directory: ./
  solution-folder: driver-portal/src/ClientApp/
  CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: rlespinasse/git-commit-data-action@v1.x
      - name: Extract Branch Name
        shell: bash
        run: echo "##[set-output name=branch;]$(echo ${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/})"
        id: extract_branch
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18.16'
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}

      - run: npm run lint
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}

      - run: npm run build --if-present
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}
      - name: Test
        run: |          
          npm install
          npm test --codeCoverage=true --watch=false
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}
        
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2.1.0
        with:
          name: DMFT
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          # Flag upload to group coverage metrics (e.g. unittests | integration | ui,chrome)

          # Environment variables to tag the upload with (e.g. PYTHON | OS,PYTHON)

name: ci-driver-portal-api

on:
  push:
     branches: [main] #codecov uses default branch for dashboard stat. recommended change the default branch from main to dev
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, edited, synchronize]
    paths:
      - "driver-portal/src/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ci-driver-portal-api.yml"

env:
  working-directory: ./
  solution-folder: driver-portal/src/  
  IMAGE_NAME: driver-portal-api
  BUILD_ID: ${{ github.server_url }}!${{ github.repository }}!${{ github.ref_name }}!${{ github.sha }}!${{ github.run_number }}
  RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
  BUILD_PREFIX: ${{ vars.versionprefix }}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: rlespinasse/git-commit-data-action@v1.x
      - name: Extract Branch Name
        shell: bash
        run: echo "##[set-output name=branch;]$(echo ${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/})"
        id: extract_branch
      - name: Setup .NET 
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v1
        with:
          dotnet-version: "6.0.x"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}

      - name: Install coverlet for code coverage
        run: dotnet tool install -g coverlet.console --version 1.7.2
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release 
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}

      - name: Test
        run: |          
          dotnet test -c Release --verbosity normal           
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}
      
      - name: Generate code coverage
        working-directory: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}
        run: |
          mkdir -p CovTestResults
          rm -rf .Tests/TestResults
          dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --settings Tests/coverlet.runsettings --no-restore
          mv Tests/TestResults/*/* ./CovTestResults/
          head CovTestResults/coverage.opencover.xml      
      
      - name: Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2.1.0
        with:
          # User defined upload name. Visible in Codecov UI
          name: DMF-driver-portal-API
          # Repository upload token - get it from codecov.io. Required only for private repositories
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ${{env.working-directory}}${{env.solution-folder}}CovTestResults/coverage.opencover.xml
          # Flag upload to group coverage portal (e.g. unittests | integration | ui,chrome)
          flags: unittests
          # Environment variables to tag the upload with (e.g. PYTHON | OS,PYTHON)
          env_vars: C#
          # Specify whether or not CI build should fail if Codecov runs into an error during upload
          fail_ci_if_error: true

      - name: Build image
        run: |
          echo BUILD_ID=$BUILD_ID
          echo "BUILD VERSION=$BUILD_PREFIX`expr $RUN_NUMBER % 256`"                 
          docker build --tag $IMAGE_NAME --build-arg BUILD_ID --build-arg BUILD_VERSION="$BUILD_PREFIX`expr $RUN_NUMBER % 256`" . --file ./driver-portal/src/Dockerfile --tag $IMAGE_NAME

public class AuthorizeDriverAttribute : Attribute, IFilterFactory
{
    public string ParameterName { get; set; } = "driverId";
    public bool IsReusable => false;

    public IFilterMetadata CreateInstance(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        var filter = (AuthorizeDriver)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(AuthorizeDriver));
        filter.ParameterName = ParameterName;
        return filter;
    }
    
    public class AuthorizeDriver : IAsyncAuthorizationFilter
    {
        private readonly IUserService _userService;
        public string ParameterName { get; set; }

        public AuthorizeDriver(IUserService userService) { _userService = userService; }

        public async Task OnAuthorizationAsync(AuthorizationFilterContext context)
        {
            var parameterValue = context.RouteData.Values[ParameterName]?.ToString();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameterValue))
            {
                context.Result = new BadRequestObjectResult($"Missing {ParameterName} parameter.");
                return;
            }
            var isAuthorized = await _userService.IsDriverAuthorized(parameterValue);
            if (!isAuthorized) context.Result = new UnauthorizedResult();
        }
    }
}
```

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;
using Rsbc.Dmf.DriverPortal.Api.Services;
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Rsbc.Dmf.DriverPortal.Api.Model.Attribute
{
    public class AuthorizeDriverAttribute : System.Attribute, IFilterFactory
    {
        public string ParameterName { get; set; } = "driverId";
        public bool IsReusable => false;

        public IFilterMetadata CreateInstance(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            var filter = (AuthorizeDriver)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(AuthorizeDriver));
            filter.ParameterName = ParameterName;
            return filter;
        }

        public class AuthorizeDriver : IAsyncAuthorizationFilter
        {
            private readonly IUserService _userService;

            public string ParameterName { get; set; }

            public AuthorizeDriver(IUserService userService)
            {
                _userService = userService;
            }

            public async Task OnAuthorizationAsync(AuthorizationFilterContext context)
            {
                var parameterValue = context.RouteData.Values[ParameterName]?.ToString();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameterValue))
                {
                    context.Result = new BadRequestObjectResult($"Missing required parameter '{ParameterName}'.");
                    return;
                }

                var isAuthorized = await _userService.IsDriverAuthorized(parameterValue);
                if (!isAuthorized)
                {
                    context.Result = new UnauthorizedResult();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
